# Studying the world
Some things in the world around you hold scientific interest. You can use a thaumaturgic magnifying glass to study them and gain knowledge.
Some examples:
- Ancient books. Can randomly appear in crates and bookshelves across the city. - Essence nodes. Periodically vanish and reappear around the world, only visible while wearing thaumaturgic goggles. - The results of infusion altar crafts.
